mapper.update: UPDATE budget_adjustment_operation SET state_json=#{stateJson},version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND command_json=#{commandJson} AND command_digest=#{digest} AND active_request_id=request_id AND retired_version IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM budget_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM budget_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_request_id=#{requestId}
SELECT * FROM budget_adjustment_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND request_id=#{requestId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT state_json,version FROM budget_adjustment_operation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{id} ORDER BY version
SELECT state_json FROM budget_adjustment_operation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND operation_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,a.business_no,NULL AS process_instance_id FROM budget_adjustment_operation q LEFT JOIN approval_application a ON a.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND a.id=q.application_id WHERE q.retired_version IS NULL AND ((q.status IN ('QUEUED','UNKNOWN') AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status IN ('EXECUTING','QUERYING') AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil})) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT process_instance_id FROM approval_submission_round WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND round_no=#{roundNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE budget_adjustment_operation SET active_request_id=NULL,retired_version=#{operationVersion} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{operationId} AND version=#{version} AND active_request_id=request_id AND retired_version IS NULL
